title: Ugaritic texts summoning dead Nephilim

tellings.quote: We know because there are eucharitic texts that have been discovered that have uh that have summoning rights that are summoning dead Nephilim.

plain: Ancient Ugaritic texts, writings from the old Canaanite city of Ugarit, are said to contain rites for summoning the dead Nephilim, the giants mentioned in the Bible. Tim Alberino, a researcher who says he took part in capturing a giant in Afghanistan, tells Michels this without naming a particular text: "there are Ugaritic texts that have been discovered that have summoning rites that are summoning dead Nephilim." He uses it as evidence that the Nephilim were real beings.
